title: Project Glasswing: Mythos Preview finds 10,000+ serious vulnerabilities in 30 days
summary: Anthropic reported that Claude Mythos Preview and ~50 partners flagged over 10,000 high/critical vulnerabilities (1,094 confirmed high/critical after review), including a 27-year-old OpenBSD bug; Mozilla fixed 271 Firefox flaws.
reason: Concrete evidence of frontier offensive-grade cyber capability, used defensively; partner disclosures partly corroborate.

title: Japan's government and banks to get access to Claude Mythos for cyber defence
summary: Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said Japan's government would get access to Anthropic's Mythos later in May to strengthen cyber defence, alongside a cybersecurity working group with major banks.
reason: Allied state access to a restricted cyber-capable model for defence (Kyodo via Japan Today).

title: Anthropic closes $30B+ round at ~$900B valuation; OpenAI files confidentially for IPO
summary: Anthropic raised over $30B led by Sequoia, Dragoneer, Altimeter and Greenoaks at a ~$900B valuation, and OpenAI confidentially filed for an IPO at a reported ~$852B valuation.
reason: Capital concentrating in two frontier labs. Exact day uncertain (reported May 18-29); best-supported ~May 22.
